transcript: Page 1: Tuesday morning.

Panel 1. Tuesday, a little after ten. On Tuesday morning finance asked us which provider had answered a call, and nobody on the team could say. Maren: Which provider answered, and what did it cost? On screen: invoice: one line / provider: ?
Panel 2. Jonas sent over the invoice, and Priya wrote that support had no idea either. Tomas: The gateway should know.
Panel 3. You were two days into the job, so Tomasz and I asked you to find out. You: I will start with the log.
Panel 4. A small copy of the system. On screen: $ gateway --log / 200 ok support-a / 4xx key expired
Page 2: Your turn.
Panel 5. Tomasz built the gateway, and I told you where he keeps the log. Maren: Send it a few calls. Tomas: Then read what it kept.
Panel 6. Your turn. So now it is your turn: open the log and tell us who answered. On screen: $ cat /workspace/answers.json / ready.

bubbles.text: This one took ages. Why did the assistant take so long to answer?

panels.voiceover: Support wrote to us a little after two: one request had taken ages.

bubbles.text: And what did it cost? I need a number per request.

panels.voiceover: Then finance asked what it had cost.

bubbles.text: That request was traced end to end. One request, four services, six spans. Read it.

panels.voiceover: I knew we had traced that request from end to end.

bubbles.text: The trace is in the lab.

panels.voiceover: Tomasz pointed you to the trace.

panels.caption: A small copy of the stack, and a trace to read.
panels.voiceover: The lab holds a small copy of the stack.
lines: slowest span, not the top one: ?

bubbles.text: Can customers see any of this?
Only what we decide to show them.

panels.voiceover: Maybe the customer could see some of it, I wondered.

bubbles.text: Write down what you find, in numbers.

panels.voiceover: Tomasz asked you to put it in numbers.

panels.caption: Your turn.
panels.voiceover: And that was the whole brief.
The lab is open, so go and have a look.

panels.voiceover: By Friday we knew which provider had answered.
The alias had moved and nobody had noticed.
Here is the line that told us.
Now you know where to look.
